title: Ask for a prediction, then explain the outcome
before: The learner has seen a relationship in one case.
after: They can use that relationship in a changed case.
sequence: Let the learner commit or choose to reveal.
Explain why the result follows, including incorrect answers.

source.title: The paradox of the derivative

observation: The page asks readers to infer motion from a graph and includes a question about a negative tangent slope.

avoid: Testing a fact that has not been introduced.

Adding compulsory predictions for every implementation detail.
check: Ask for a reason or a new case, not only the answer.
